title: Beam main-bar extension into each support, in bar diameters
source: typical anchorage
rationale: Bottom and top bars run the clear span plus this anchorage at both ends; 0 is the bare clear span.

title: What the schedule beam depth H is measured from
source: beam schedule (datum not printed on most Kuwait villa schedules)
rationale: TOTAL_DEPTH (B x H x L, the slab strip inside H) is the usual schedule convention; BELOW_SLAB (B x (H + t) x L) is the alternative and sets each beam's high end.

title: Blinding projection beyond the member it is under, each side
source: blinding laid wider than the footing / beam it carries
rationale: Not printed on most villa sets; 10 cm each side is usual, 5 - 15 cm the range.

title: Blinding thickness when not printed (exposure only)
source: typical villa blinding
rationale: Only an exposure for UNRESOLVED blinding (never added to a total); blinding is measured only with a printed thickness (profile).

title: Blinding (plain concrete) thickness
source: ST7757 PDF p.13 typical isolated-footing detail and ground-beam details: '10cm Plain con.' - read by OCR (notes P13N01, P13N02 in evidence/DETAIL_EVIDENCE.json), not glyph-checked and not reviewed; the frozen M1 replay held footing blinding UNRESOLVED for want of this value
rationale: Both typical details print a 10 cm plain-concrete layer; to be confirmed by a person (RFI M3-RFI-06).

title: Members that sit on blinding
source: ST7757 PDF p.13: the plain-concrete layer is drawn in the footing detail and in the ground-beam details
rationale: Both typical details show the layer.

title: Untagged span collinear with a tagged span across a support
source: drawing convention: one tag per beam line
rationale: An untagged span on the same line, same width, across a column inherits the tagged section (LOW confidence). OFF leaves it UNRESOLVED.

title: Column main-bar lap per storey, in bar diameters
source: typical lap
rationale: Each storey's main bars run the storey height plus one lap.

title: Column drawn at another section than its schedule
source: drawn outline vs schedule storey band
rationale: Schedule as base; drawn as the alternative.

title: Footing bar ends
source: footing details
rationale: Straight between covers as base; 90 deg hooks at both ends as the high end.

title: Two footing types labelled at one footing with no outline
source: the two labelled schedule types
rationale: One physical footing carries two type labels and no outline settles it: it is quantified once, at the larger type (the conservative reading), with the smaller as the low bound. An RFI settles the type.

title: Footing mark with a schedule row but no outline found
source: footing schedule size of the labelled type
rationale: The label and its schedule type are certain; the outline is not found. The quantity is the schedule size, PROVISIONAL and LOW confidence, with a coverage-risk record; a second label next to an outline of the same type stays unresolved (never counted twice).

title: Footing drawn at another plan size than its schedule
source: drawn outline vs schedule row
rationale: Schedule as base; the drawn size is the alternative.

title: Footing outline with only a column mark
source: drawn outline vs footing schedule sizes
rationale: When exactly one footing type has the drawn plan size, the outline is that type (LOW confidence; an RFI confirms it).

title: Founding level below plot level (footing underside)
source: ST7757 general note (PDF, transcribed): excavation not less than 1.50 m below plot level
rationale: The printed minimum is the base and the low end; 2.00 m is a planning upper bound, not printed (RFI).

title: Depth range for an unmarked ground beam (exposure only)
source: villa ground beams
rationale: Used only for the UNRESOLVED exposure range; never in a total.

title: Floor build-up between the floor level and the top of an exterior ground beam
source: tiled floor on screed (finish + bedding)
rationale: The exterior depth runs from the slab level under the floor finish to the outer ground level; the finish thickness is not printed.

title: A perimeter ground beam takes the printed exterior detail
source: band side classification of the ground-beam plan (slab_engine.band_sides: a long side with no slab cell and no member beyond it)
rationale: A ground beam on the outside of the ground-beam network carries the exterior wall, so the printed exterior detail applies; the typical class section is the alternative and sets the low end of the range.

title: Printed exterior ground-beam detail
source: ST7757 PDF p.13 'Ground Beams. for exterior walls' (labels 'Ground Floor slab level' and 'Outer Normal ground level'); bars from the detail-evidence document
rationale: The exterior detail spans from the ground-floor slab level to the outer ground level; width as the typical sections (30 cm).

title: Span length that selects a typical ground-beam class
source: typical section titles by span
rationale: Span conventionally means centre to centre; the clear-length class is the alternative.

title: Typical ground-beam sections by span (ST7757 p.13 titles)
source: ST7757.pdf p.13 typical ground-beam titles '< 2.5 m (30x30)', '< 5 m (30x40)', '> 5 m (30x60)' (vector glyphs; typed)
rationale: Read as exclusive span bands; exterior beams 'FOLLOW ARCH.' are not separated by the generic route (a known limit).

title: Ground-floor level above plot level
source: GF level +1.00 printed on the architectural section P7757 VE-AA-09 and on the ground-beam plan (+1.00)
rationale: The top of the exterior ground-beam detail is the ground-floor slab level.

title: Foundation neck height when the founding level is not printed (exposure only)
source: typical villa necks
rationale: Only an exposure for an UNRESOLVED neck (never added to a total); a neck is measured only with the printed founding depth and neck top level of the project (profile).

title: Top of the foundation necks (GF level above plot level)
source: GF level +1.00 printed on the architectural section P7757 VE-AA-09 (the lift stops GF +1.00, 1F +5.50)
rationale: The neck runs from its footing top to the GF level, where the GF column starts (its height is GF +1.00 to 1F +5.50 = 4.50).

title: Outer ground level beside the building
source: levels printed outside the building on the ground-beam plan (SH08): +-0.00 and +0.15
rationale: The exterior detail runs down to the outer normal ground level; the plan prints +-0.00 and +0.15 outside the building, which set the range.

title: Beam cover to links
source: typical general notes
rationale: Overridden by a printed cover in the profile.

title: Column cover to ties
source: typical general notes
rationale: Overridden by a printed cover in the profile.

title: Footing cover
source: typical general notes
rationale: Overridden by a printed cover in the profile.

title: Code table for bends and hooks
source: engine.source.bbs_optimiser ACI 318-19 Tables 25.3.1 / 25.3.2 (not verified against a project document)
rationale: Diameter-aware bend diameters and hook tails; PROVISIONAL_CODE_METHOD.

title: A mark with two schedule rows
source: the schedule rows and the drawn width of the bound band
rationale: When one mark has two schedule rows and the drawn width matches exactly one of them, that row is the base; the other row gives the range. A drawn width that matches neither or both leaves the member UNRESOLVED.

title: Reading of a side-bar notation 'n Ø d / s'
source: typical-detail notation
rationale: The printed count is the base; bars at the printed spacing on each face over the section height give the high end.

title: Directions of a slab mesh tag that does not say each way
source: slab bar tag without E.W.
rationale: A tag without E.W. covers one direction as base; both directions as the high end.

title: A sheet's single each-way mesh note applies to untagged panels
source: printed sheet note 'n Ø d /m E.W.'
rationale: One each-way mesh note on the sheet and no tag inside the panel: the note applies (scope confirmed by RFI).

title: Untagged panels take the sheet's single printed thickness
source: every thickness tag on the sheet prints the same value
rationale: When all printed tags agree the sheet value applies to untagged panels.

title: Thickness range for a panel with no printed thickness (exposure only)
source: Kuwait villa slab range
rationale: Used only for the UNRESOLVED exposure range; never in a total.

title: Storey height 1F (floor to floor)
source: P7757 architectural section VE-AA-09 (printed floor-to-floor)
rationale: Typed from the printed section.

title: Storey height 2F (floor to floor)
source: P7757 architectural section VE-AA-09 (printed floor-to-floor)
rationale: Typed from the printed section.

title: Storey height GF (floor to floor)
source: P7757 architectural section VE-AA-09 (printed floor-to-floor)
rationale: Typed from the printed section.

title: Depth range for an untagged beam band with no schedule row at its width (exposure only)
source: villa beam depths
rationale: Used only for the UNRESOLVED exposure; when schedule rows exist at the band width their depth range is used instead.

title: Width of a beam drawn at another width than its schedule
source: drawn band width vs schedule row
rationale: The schedule is the design table; the drawn width is the alternative.
